what: Six sharing pause points outside Firestore transactions: before document/team membership transactions, after document commit before mirroring, around cascade document discovery, and before visibility mirroring. Transaction conflict retries are exercised separately by deterministic unit tests; these gates order complete requests without holding pessimistic locks.

gates.name: doc-membership-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts persistDocMembership: before its transaction; skipped for the cascade, whose separate gate controls discovery

gates.name: doc-mirror-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts persistDocMembership: after commit, before rereading the authoritative document and mirroring its revision

gates.name: subtree-before-docs-read
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts recomputeSubtree: after the folder's own membership is written, before the query that reads the documents filed in it

gates.name: subtree-docs-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts recomputeSubtree: after discovering document ids, before their membership transactions

gates.name: team-members-after-read
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts manageTeamMembers: before the membership transaction (legacy gate name retained)

gates.name: visibility-before-mirror
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts setVisibility: after record/projection writes, before rereading current membership for the realtime mirror
